items.name: Catch2
items.description: A modern, C++-native, test framework for unit-tests, TDD and BDD - using C++14, C++17 and later (C++11 support is in v2.x branch, and C++03 on the Catch1.x branch)

descriptions.zh: 用于单元测试、TDD 和 BDD 的现代 C++ 原生测试框架 - 使用 C++14、C++17 及更高版本（C++11 支持位于 v2.x 分支，C++03 支持 Catch1.x 分支）
descriptions.en: A modern, C++-native, test framework for unit-tests, TDD and BDD - using C++14, C++17 and later (C++11 support is in v2.x branch, and C++03 on the Catch1.x branch)

items.name: claude-code-templates
items.description: CLI tool for configuring and monitoring Claude Code

descriptions.zh: 用于配置和监控 Claude Code 的 CLI 工具
descriptions.en: CLI tool for configuring and monitoring Claude Code

items.name: stitch-skills
items.description: A library of Agent Skills designed to work with the Stitch MCP server. Each skill follows the Agent Skills open standard, for compatibility with coding agents such as Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Cursor.

descriptions.zh: 旨在与 Stitch MCP 服务器配合使用的代理技能库。每个技能都遵循 Agent Skills 开放标准，以便与 Antigravity、Gemini CLI、Claude Code、Cursor 等编码代理兼容。
descriptions.en: A library of Agent Skills designed to work with the Stitch MCP server. Each skill follows the Agent Skills open standard, for compatibility with coding agents such as Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Cursor.

items.name: terraform
items.description: Terraform enables you to safely and predictably create, change, and improve infrastructure. It is a source-available tool that codifies APIs into declarative configuration files that can be shared amongst team members, treated as code, edited, reviewed, and versioned.

descriptions.zh: Terraform 使您能够安全且可预测地创建、更改和改进基础设施。它是一个源可用的工具，可将 API 编码为声明性配置文件，这些文件可以在团队成员之间共享、视为代码、进行编辑、审查和版本控制。
descriptions.en: Terraform enables you to safely and predictably create, change, and improve infrastructure. It is a source-available tool that codifies APIs into declarative configuration files that can be shared amongst team members, treated as code, edited, reviewed, and versioned.

items.name: meshoptimizer
items.description: Mesh optimization library that makes meshes smaller and faster to render

descriptions.zh: 网格优化库，使网格更小、渲染速度更快
descriptions.en: Mesh optimization library that makes meshes smaller and faster to render
